purpose: Controlled same-photographer real-image COLMAP experiment. This remains exploratory, not a surveyed/cadastral model, and is not map-ready.

independentReferenceDimensions.caveat: These published dimensions are a reference baseline, not a survey. Some sources use a slightly different overall-depth figure; this experiment uses 28.75 m as the declared comparison value.

reviewMethod.scaleCalibration: The first-pass reconstruction is measured in model units. A second run scales only the longest horizontal dimension to the published 125.4 m length. The calibrated long-axis match is therefore not independent accuracy evidence.
independentDimensionChecks: short horizontal principal dimension versus 28.75 m overall depth
vertical axis extent versus 27.13 m dome peak
reviewMethod.axisAssumption: The run declares Y as the candidate up axis to satisfy the worker contract. COLMAP's local reconstruction frame is not inherently WGS84-oriented, so this assumption must be checked in the orthographic previews.
reviewMethod.georeferencing: Not claimed. Scale calibration alone does not solve horizontal WGS84 placement or vertical datum.
reviewMethod.visualReview: The artifact includes the licensed reference photographs plus front, side and top orthographic previews of the output GLB for direct visual comparison.
reviewMethod.note: This controlled experiment replaces the previous mixed-author photo set with six same-photographer stills captured on 30 September 2016. Visual review shows dome-focused views (02/06), broad frontal/oblique views (03/05/07), and a long side-wing view (04). The set is not a continuous walk-around; the common Commons coordinate is not treated as surveyed camera-pose evidence. A pass still requires independent depth/height, registered-image coverage, sufficient viewing-direction spread, topology review, source-image comparison, and WGS84/GCP registration.
